metrics.title: 当前库表数量
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE'

metrics.title: 当前库列总数
metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = DATABASE()

metrics.title: 表行数 Top10
metrics.sql: SELECT table_name AS label, table_rows AS count FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = DATABASE() AND table_type = 'BASE TABLE' ORDER BY table_rows DESC LIMIT 10
